title: ID0372380-DC/SI-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000686]-HMI LED malfunctioning
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On this charger, the LED light on the Left Side that indicates the availability of the charger is out of service. Indeed, if you see the photo, sometimes it is purple or OFF and it's never green even if the outlet 1 is available. Can you send the ticket to the French Team please to replace it ? or to see if there is a wire connection problem in the LED motion control ?
